original_content_full:
Jan Eric Kyprianidis at NPAR and SIGGRAPH 2011

At NPAR 2011, Jan Eric presented his paper on "Image and Video Abstraction by Multi-scale Anisotropic Kuwahara Filtering". NPAR 2011 was part of the 2011 Joint Session of the Symposia on Computational Aestethics, Sketch-Based Interfaces and Modeling, and Non-Photorealistic Animation and Rendering (CAE-SBIM-NPAR), which was held in Vancouver from 5-7 August and was collocated with SIGGRAPH 2011. Jan Eric also chaired the Session on Visualization and Beautification at the Symposia. Taking the chance, he also visited SIGGRAPH 2011, held from 7-11 August, 2011.
